---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a bounded, testable improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem and outcome

What operator or research problem should this solve? Define an observable outcome.

## Proposed boundary

Which crate/UI/provider owns it? Which values belong in `.cfg`? How does it preserve
deterministic risk, execution, reconciliation, and point-in-time replay semantics?

## Acceptance evidence

List the tests, fixtures, benchmarks, runbook steps, or packaged evidence that would
prove the feature complete. Do not propose success-only stubs or live-provider tests.
